transcript: The other night, I attended The Apiary at Second Stage. This is a new play by Kate Douglas, mostly following three women working in a lab 22 years in the future. They’re monitoring the dying bee population and get themselves into a bit of a Little Shop of Horrors kind of situation. I saw a reading of this play at Second Stage’s Next Stage Festival last year, and I really enjoyed it. And although not everything translated nicely from page to stage for me, I really like the play and I think it's conceptually very cool and difficult to stage so overall they did a good job. The play itself is pretty funny, but it gets kind of dark and it's about bees, but it's also about bureaucracy, consequences, humanity, big picture stuff. The cast is great, the set is cool, and it's also less than 90 minutes long. If this is calling you, The Apiary is running through February 25th. With that, another program for my collection.
